scripts.check: npm run check:versions && npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm test
scripts.lint: npm run lint:js && npm run lint:rust
scripts.format:check: npm run format:check:js && npm run format:check:rust
scripts.format: npm run format:js && npm run format:rust
scripts.test: npm run test:js && npm run test:rust
scripts.build:check: npm run sync:design-system && npm run prepare:social-runtime && cargo build --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --locked --release --features custom-protocol
scripts.build: npm run sync:version && npm run prepare:whisper-runtime && npm run prepare:ffmpeg-runtime && npm run prepare:deno-runtime && tauri build
scripts.build:windows: npm run sync:version && npm run prepare:windows-runtime && tauri build --target x86_64-pc-windows-msvc
scripts.build:adhoc-dmg: bash -lc 'set -euo pipefail; npm run build -- --bundles app; APP="src-tauri/target/release/bundle/macos/PineFetch.app"; if [ ! -d "$APP" ]; then echo "App not found at $APP"; exit 1; fi; codesign --force --deep --sign - "$APP"; codesign --verify --deep --strict --verbose=2 "$APP"; mkdir -p src-tauri/target/release/bundle/dmg; VERSION=$(node -p "require(\"./src-tauri/tauri.conf.json\").version"); OUT="src-tauri/target/release/bundle/dmg/PineFetch_${VERSION}_aarch64_adhoc.dmg"; hdiutil create -volname "PineFetch" -srcfolder "$APP" -ov -format UDZO "$OUT"; echo "Created $OUT";'
scripts.check:fast: npm run check:versions && npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run test:fast
scripts.test:fast: npm run test:js && npm run test:rust:fast
